about: Generated by scripts/pricing/p5-published-figures.mts from the P5 instant estimator (priceEstimate then customerEstimate, seed cost book, default scope settings, no database). Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.

source.rounding: published low = estimator low rounded down, published high = estimator high rounded up, to $1,000 at or above $10,000 and to $100 below
